name: McCormick
description: McCormick is a global spice and seasoning company (brand leader globally in spices and seasonings, per its 10-K), selling McCormick, Lawry's, Zatarain's, Old Bay, French's, Frank's RedHot and Cholula in grocery, mass and club stores in about 150 countries, plus a large private-label supply business. Its Flavor Solutions segment supplies multinational food manufacturers and foodservice customers. On 2026-01-02 it paid $750M to raise its stake in McCormick de Mexico from 50 to 75 percent, which helped lift first-half fiscal 2026 net sales 16.7 percent and produced an $866.8M one-time gain. On 2026-03-31 it agreed to combine with the Unilever Foods business in a Reverse Morris Trust, with Unilever holders ending up with about 55 percent of the combined company.

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01); that list does not show industry group or industry.

hq.note: EDGAR business address; Wikipedia S&P 500 list

businessLines.name: Consumer
businessLines.how: Sells branded and private-label products to grocery, mass, club, discount, drug and e-commerce retailers, directly or through distributors; brand premium plus scale in sourcing spices.
businessLines.description: Branded spices, seasonings, condiments and sauces in the Americas (McCormick, French's, Frank's RedHot, Lawry's, Cholula, Club House, Old Bay, Zatarain's), EMEA (Ducros, Schwartz, Kamis, Vahine) and APAC (McCormick, DaQiao); about two-thirds is spices, seasonings, condiments and sauces; also a leading supplier of private-label store brands; China foodservice is reported here.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income excluding special charges; share is of the two segments' $1,094.0M; vs $740.3M FY2024 (-0.7%)

businessLines.name: Flavor Solutions
businessLines.how: B2B: sells flavour and seasoning products to food manufacturers and foodservice customers; lower margin (12.4 percent) than Consumer (18.6 percent).
businessLines.description: A wide range of products for multinational food manufacturers and foodservice customers (branded packaged products to foodservice directly and through distributors).

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income excluding special charges; vs $329.5M FY2024 (+9.0%)

brands.name: McCormick, French's, Frank's RedHot, Lawry's, Cholula, Club House, Gourmet Garden, Old Bay
brands.note: Leading Consumer brands in the Americas (revenue per brand not disclosed)

brands.name: Zatarain's, Stubb's, Thai Kitchen, Simply Asia
Ducros, Schwartz, Kamis, La Drogheria, Vahine
McCormick de Mexico
brands.note: 75 percent owned and fully consolidated since 2026-01-02 (Grupo Herdez holds the rest); mayonnaise, spices, marmalades, mustard, hot sauce, tea

whatsNext.text: Reverse Morris Trust merger with Unilever Foods (agreement 2026-03-31): Unilever shareholders to own about 55.1 percent, McCormick holders about 35.0 percent, Unilever up to about 9.9 percent; Unilever also gets a one-time $15.7B cash payment funded by a bridge facility; excludes Unilever's foods businesses in India, Nepal and Portugal, Lifestyle & Nutrition, Buavita and Lipton RTD; needs McCormick shareholder approval, HSR and other antitrust approvals and an effective Form S-4; $420M termination fee payable by McCormick in specified cases. Expected closing date not found in the text read
